question: What is the area of the largest windmill in the image given the GSD of 0.868?
final_answer_preview:
The largest windmill in the image has a bounding box of **88 pixels in width and height**. Using the GSD of **0.868 meters/pixel**, the real-world dimensions are:

- Width: $ 88 \text{ pixels} \times 0.868 \text{ m/pixel} = 76.384 \text{ m} $
- Height: $ 88 \text{ pixels} \times 0.868 \text{ m/pixel} = 76.384 \text{ m} $

**Area** = $ 76.384 \text{ m} \times 76.384 \text{ m} \approx 5,833 \text{ m}^2 $.

**Answer:** The largest windmill has an area of approximately **5,833 square meters**.
